unwise--adj.def: Not sensible and likely to cause trouble.
unwise--adj.ex: It would be unwise to wait.

aspire--verb.def: To have a strong wish to achieve something.
aspire--verb.ex: She aspires to be a surgeon.

ponder--verb.def: To think carefully about something for a while.
ponder--verb.ex: He pondered the offer for days.

fingernail--noun.def: The hard covering at the end of a finger.

refinery--noun.def: A factory where oil or sugar is made pure.

allegation--noun.def: A claim that someone has done wrong, not yet proved.

polio--noun.def: A serious disease that can paralyse children.

lastly--adv.def: Used to introduce the final point.

micro--noun.def: A short form used to mean very small.

facilitate--verb.def: To make something easier to happen.

vigorous--adj.exTr: Her gün güçlü bir egzersiz yaptı.

excel--verb.def: To be extremely good at something.

reggae--noun.def: A style of popular music from Jamaica.

overcoat--noun.def: A long warm coat worn over other clothes.
overcoat--noun.ex: He hung his overcoat by the door.

ethic--noun.def: A set of moral beliefs that guides behaviour.
ethic--noun.ex: The company has a strong work ethic.
ethic--noun.exTr: Şirketin güçlü bir çalışma ahlakı var.

partisan--noun.def: A strong supporter of a side, or a resistance fighter.
partisan--noun.ex: The partisans hid in the forest.

bony--adj.def: Very thin, so that the bones show.

trusty--adj.def: Reliable, used in an old-fashioned or joking way.
trusty--adj.ex: He took his trusty old bicycle.

radically--adv.def: In a complete and extreme way.

vibrate--verb.def: To shake with small quick movements.
vibrate--verb.ex: The phone vibrated on the table.

aggressively--adv.def: In an angry or forceful way.

inflammation--noun.def: A red swollen painful area of the body.

trample--noun.def: The act of walking heavily over something.
trample--noun.ex: The trample of boots woke us.

unbeatable--adj.def: Impossible to defeat or to better.

geographic--adj.def: Relating to the physical features of an area.

appropriately--adv.def: In a way that is right for the situation.

compulsory--adj.def: Required by a rule or a law.

unrealistic--adj.def: Not sensible about what is possible.

nutshell--noun.def: The hard shell of a nut, used to mean a short summary.

admittedly--adv.def: Used when accepting that something is true.
admittedly--adv.exTr: Kabul etmek gerekir ki plan riskli.

olympia--noun.def: The ancient Greek site where the first games were held.
olympia--noun.ex: The flame is lit at Olympia.

assert--verb.def: To state something firmly as true.
assert--verb.ex: She asserted her right to speak.

fiscal--adj.def: Relating to government money and taxes.
fiscal--adj.ex: The fiscal year ends in March.

jeweler--noun.def: A person or shop that sells and repairs jewellery.

suburb--noun.def: An area of houses on the edge of a city.
suburb--noun.ex: They moved to a quiet suburb.

aristocracy--noun.def: The people of the highest social class.

deem--verb.def: To consider something to be a certain way, in formal English.

self-confidence--noun.ex: The prize gave her self confidence.

corresponding--adj.def: Matching or related to something else.

shopkeeper--noun.def: A person who owns or runs a small shop.

provision--noun.def: A condition in an agreement, or the act of supplying.
provision--noun.ex: The contract has a special provision.

commemorate--verb.def: To honour the memory of a person or an event.

nourishment--noun.def: The food needed to grow and stay healthy.

widen--verb.def: To become wider, or to make something wider.

mobility--noun.def: The ability to move or to change your position in society.

lecturer--noun.def: A person who teaches at a university.

dissatisfied--adj.def: Not happy with what you have received.

tenderly--adv.def: In a gentle and loving way.

turbulent--adj.def: Full of sudden change and trouble.

ambiguous--adj.def: Having more than one possible meaning.

perseverance--noun.def: The quality of continuing despite difficulty.

mausoleum--noun.def: A large stone building containing a tomb.

catalyst--noun.def: Something that causes a change to happen faster.
catalyst--noun.ex: The report was a catalyst for reform.
catalyst--noun.exTr: Rapor reform için bir tetikleyici oldu.

standstill--noun.def: A situation in which nothing moves or happens.

optional--adj.def: Something you can choose, not required.

denim--noun.def: A strong cotton cloth used for jeans.

eloquent--adj.def: Able to speak or write very well and persuasively.

bitterly--adv.def: With strong sad or angry feeling, or extremely cold.

typhoid--noun.def: A serious disease spread by dirty water.

repetition--noun.def: The act of doing or saying something again.

improbable--adj.def: Not likely to be true or to happen.

lengthy--adj.def: Continuing for a long time, often too long.

decorative--adj.def: Meant to look attractive rather than to be useful.

correspond--verb.def: To match something, or to exchange letters.

shipwreck--noun.def: A ship destroyed at sea, or the event itself.
shipwreck--noun.exTr: Dalgıçlar eski bir gemi enkazı buldu.

attribute--noun.def: A quality that someone or something has.

attribute--verb.def: To say that something was caused by or made by someone.
attribute--verb.ex: They attribute the win to teamwork.

pessimistic--adj.ex: He is pessimistic about the harvest.

erupt--verb.def: To throw out lava, or to begin suddenly and violently.

skim--verb.def: To read quickly, or to take something off a surface.

foolishly--adv.def: In a way that shows poor judgement.
